question: Can a credential-free task bank engineered for ASYMMETRIC discovery - multi-task sessions in which one-time session/resource/schema discovery is amortized or cached across tasks, and therefore materially different from the bounded-negative mandatory-discovery deterministic REST class - receive a PRE-FREEZE, arithmetically checkable dynamic-range certificate (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED success_rate < 0.95 at novelty >= 0.50 on at least one family, matched correctness >= 0.80 for all arms, and a treatment/comparator distinction) so that it can serve as the reusable substrate that unblocks the flagship inheritance benchmark (B2), recording a bounded substrate-class negative and freezing nothing if the certificate is unsatisfiable on every credential-free substrate tested?
hypothesis: There exists at least one credential-free asymmetric-discovery task bank family such that, under the frozen arithmetic certificate, the retrieval-shaped comparator and the cold re-derive arm are NOT at ceiling (success < 0.95) while matched correctness >= 0.80 for all arms and treatment/comparator are distinguishable; otherwise the substrate class is bounded negative and no freeze occurs.
falsifier: For every credential-free asymmetric-discovery task bank candidate examined in the pre-freeze scan, the arithmetical certificate is unsatisfiable (either B-COLD-RE-DERIVE >= 0.95 and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED >= 0.95 at novelty>=0.50 on all eligible families, or matched correctness < 0.80 on any arm, or treatment/comparator distinction is not demonstrable), with the scan covering at least two independent families and all mandatory checks PASS as preconditions. The result is a bounded substrate-class negative recorded per packet contract; no freeze occurs.

baselines.description: No reuse beyond minimal environment setup; session/resource/schema discovery performed when required per task (cold re-derivation). Baseline for ceiling detection in asymmetric-discovery setting.
baselines.threshold_basis: prevents conflating mandatory discovery with amortized discovery; ensures dynamic range exists

baselines.description: Strong retrieval-shaped comparator over prior trajectories/fragments (instruction+retrieval style comparator) matched to tasks, to certify it is not at ceiling when amortization exists.
baselines.threshold_basis: guards against 1.0 retrieval ceiling observed in prior product packets

positive_control.description: Matched correctness guard: all arms (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE, B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED, any T candidate) must achieve matched_correctness >= 0.80 under identical task instantiation to ensure the ceiling test is not driven by correctness collapse.

null_control.description: Treatment/comparator distinction control: the candidate treatment T must be structurally/computationally distinguishable from B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED and from B-COLD-RE-DERIVE (different mechanism path/affordance or non-identical action set under arm-blind scoring). Identity is a design failure.

measurement_validity.description: Scoring must be arm-blind (no arm label available to scorer); violations are not tolerated.
Certificate requires novelty >= 0.50 on at least one family to avoid trivial mandatory-discovery cases.

Candidate bank is credential-free and exhibits asymmetric discovery (amortizable one-time session/resource/schema discovery across tasks). Mandatory-discovery-only deterministic REST classes are excluded by design.
Scan includes >= 2 independent task families; certificate requires the condition on >= 1 family.
Task instantiation is matched across arms (same goal/constraints, controlled novelty) to prevent comparing different task sets.

certificate_criteria: Treatment/comparator distinguishable and live (where T exists)
decision_rule.success_outcome_if_met: CERTIFICATE_SATISFIABLE (dynamic range exists) — DESIGN may proceed to freeze eligibility PASS for this bounded certificate; experiment remains pre-freeze (no execution of confirmatory measurements).
decision_rule.failure_outcome_if_not_met: CERTIFICATE_UNSATISFIABLE — bounded substrate-class negative recorded; spec.freeze_eligibility cannot reach full freeze (treatment_liveness not satisfied or ceiling persists); no freeze.json produced by execution path.

product_consequence_positive: Establishes a reusable credential-free substrate with certified dynamic range for B2 (unblocks flagship inheritance benchmark) under C-MEAS-VALID.
product_consequence_negative: Records a bounded negative for the asymmetric-discovery credential-free substrate class with arithmetic justification; avoids rediscovering ceiling degeneracy and preserves critical-path resources.
estimated_cost: low (pre-freeze satisfiability scan only; no outcome-bearing execution)
expected_information_gain: high (resolves B2 blocker before expensive C-LLM-INHERIT execution)
